rationale: The inspected paper shows how combinatorial input coverage quantifies selected attribute-value combinations and identifies insufficient data regions. It also says the relation of neuron-style coverage to performance is unclear. The claim's warning that selected input coverage alone is not a model-performance or safety-probability result is a faithful bounded interpretation of those method limits.
evidence_locators: S-EVID-002-R1 — PDF p. 3, structural versus input coverage discussion
S-EVID-002-R2 — PDF p. 5, transfer-learning and conclusion discussion
limitations: Variables, discretisation and interaction strength are analyst choices; unmodelled causal factors remain outside the measure.
This methods paper does not demonstrate a certification process, failure rate or safe closed-loop behaviour.
